steps.speaker: Andrew
steps.content: What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Albert
steps.content: What do you mean? Of course I must be here for this very important day.

steps.speaker: Albert
steps.content: Everyone in the clinic is here. We're all happy for Eve.
People gather next to the surveillance window outside the rehabilitation room, talking in hushed tones.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Good. Yes, just take it slow. First, try to support your body with the strength of your arms...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Mmm...
Eve strains to hold onto the rehabilitation equipment, slowly removing herself from the wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: All right. Then I wish that in this life, Eve can leave the factory, and live a long, happy and peaceful life.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: You're not wishing for Shanna? Benna forgot again!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: How could I forget? The one who chatted with me... the one who I watched grow up... is Eve.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bass hope Eve can make new friends! Friends smarter than Bass, so Eve won't be troubled! If Eve is happy, Bass is happy!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It hurts... where the prosthetic pulls...
Eve grits her teeth, her face already pale.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: It's a good sign you're feeling it. Keep going, Eve.

steps.speaker: Andrew & Albert
steps.content: You can do it, Eve...

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: I wish that in my next life, I'll meet Eve again! By then, we will be complete, healthy and well.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Bone still remembers its promise with Eve.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: He wishes that he can go for a walk with Eve... and be Eve's puppy again.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Go for a walk... That sounds nice. It'd be great if we could all go together.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: We said we'd... all go for a walk together...
Eve is already drenched in sweat, but she has only moved a finger's distance away from the wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Just a little more, Eve. You can do it... Just a bit more!

steps.speaker: Andrew
steps.content: How's it going? Has she stood up?

steps.speaker: Albert
steps.content: Do you think it's that easy? Eve's nerves have been dormant for years. It's already a miracle that she can feel anything!

steps.speaker: Andrew
steps.content: Then what are we waiting for here?

steps.speaker: Albert
steps.content: Tsk, can't you just shut it for a minute.

steps.speaker: Albert
steps.content: Of course, we are waiting for a miracle!
Eve.
Their wish is for you to experience tomorrow outside the factory.
It's a tomorrow that belongs to you, and one that you'll witness on their behalf.
Because of you, this family without blood ties exists.
If you move forward, the family members in your memory will also move forward.
You are their hope and continuity for the future.
Let's go. I'll take you away from here.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Tomorrow... I still have many, many tomorrows...

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Ah! Eve...
It's only for a brief moment, yet everyone sees it. Eve leaves the wheelchair.
Although she quickly falls back into the wheelchair, for that one moment, the entire clinic held their breath for her.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Did... did I do it?
Bass and Benna have said it, you're the smartest. I believe you will find your motivation.
Once you do, you'll be able to stand up and walk out of the factory, enduring the pain.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Stand up...
Go and make the lies come true. Create a better world with the accumulated tomorrows.
This is my motivation. What's yours, Eve?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Walk out...
Tell me your answer when I come back.
No matter what your answer is, this time, I will support you.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Eve, why are you crying? Did you get hurt just now?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No, I'm fine...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I did it. I found my motivation...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Those beautiful lies... One after another, they motivated me and all those who couldn't protect themselves. I see a new tomorrow now...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But Polly and the others... they can't see it...
Just the act of getting up has drained all of Eve's energy. She clutches the notebook in her wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you'll come back, right?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Eve, are you sure you want to leave the clinic?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes, I'm a Sinner of the MBCC. I can only meet the person I'm waiting for over there.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: If that's your decision, sure. Be careful! It's not particularly safe out there. Take care.
Eve nods with a smile. The doll in her hand swells up to an enormous thing to fend off some contamination for the nurse.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Well, it seems like I'm the one who needs to be more careful.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Besides waiting for that person, what else are you going to do when you're back?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Of course, there's still a lot I want to do...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'll continue my rehabilitation in the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Then, I want to see if I can help with the mechanical maintenance there.
The sky over Syndicate is all gray. Eve lifts her head, trying to find a hint of blue.
As she's gazing at the sky, lively noises come from not far away.

steps.speaker: Childish Voice
steps.content: Give me back my plane! I found it!

steps.speaker: Childish Voice
steps.content: Nah, nah, nah, I won't give it back!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: It's the group of kids we recently took in... They're causing a ruckus again.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Right, I heard one of those boys got separated from his mother at the border of the Rust and Eastside when he was a child.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Could he be the child of the Maresa you mentioned before?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: How old is he?!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: He looks around twelve or thirteen. Do you want to meet him?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: ...No. He'll be fine staying here with you guys.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: They've moved on, so I should too.
Clutching her small diary, Eve heads in the direction of the MBCC with her toys.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm sure you'll come back. I still have so many things to tell you.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You listened to my story at the factory, but I haven't had the chance to get to know you yet.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: They've told me a lot of things, all about your past as a hero.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But I also want to hear the story of the gray cloth doll when you were just an ordinary person.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The next time we meet, please tell me.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Your lies and your ideals...
